root_cause.text: The at_dma_xlate() function acquires a reference to the DMA platform device (stored in atslave->dma_dev) but never releases that reference when the channel resources are freed in atc_free_chan_resources(), causing a device reference leak on successful channel allocation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `put_device(atslave->dma_dev);` inside `atc_free_chan_resources()` before freeing the `atslave` structure. The commit message explicitly states: "Make sure to drop the reference taken when looking up the DMA platform device during of_dma_xlate() when releasing channel resources" and notes that the previous fix only addressed error paths, leaving the leak on successful allocation.
